v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Tibi soli peccávi, * Dómine, miserére mei.
text.en: Before thee only have I sinned, * O Lord, have mercy on me.

text.la: Convértere, Dómine, * et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos.
text.en: Turn thee again, O Lord, * and be gracious unto thy servants.
O God, * thou hast multiplied thy mercy.

text.la: Fortitúdo mea * et laus mea Dóminus: et factus est mihi in salútem.
text.en: The Lord is my strength * and my praise, and he is become my salvation.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum qui sanat contrítos corde, et álligat contritiónes eórum.
text.en: Praise the Lord * who healeth the broken of heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

text.la: Veníte, mittámus lignum in panem eius, et eradámus eum de terra vivéntium, et nomen eius non memorétur ámplius.
text.en: Come, let us put wood on his bread, and cut him off from the land of the living, and let his name be remembered no more.

v.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus.
v.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God.

r.la: Et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
r.en: And defend me from them that rise up against me.

text.la: Magíster dicit: * Tempus meum prope est, apud te fácio Pascha cum discípulis meis.
text.en: The Master saith: My time is at hand; * I will keep the Passover at thy house with My disciples.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut dígnitas condiciónis humánæ per immoderántiam sauciáta, medicinális parsimóniæ stúdio reformétur.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that the honour of man's nature, which gluttony hath degraded, may be seasonably renewed by strictness in keeping of this healthful Fast.
